name: Tushy
summary: Vixen Media Group's high-gloss 4K studio devoted to upscale, sunlit scenes with top performers and sleek editorial art direction.
ranking_rationale: Applies Vixen's signature cinema polish and marquee casting to a dedicated niche with standout consistency, though best bought through the Vixen Plus network pass.

pricing.notes: Varies by plan and promo; available standalone or via Vixen Plus. Check official checkout.

pros: Top-shelf 4K cinematography and bright editorial art direction
High-profile performer debuts and consistent scene quality
Clean, fast streaming player with offline downloads
cons: Single-niche library limits variety as a standalone sub
Release pace is measured rather than daily
Better cost-per-scene inside Vixen Plus than solo

facts.value: Launched 2015; operated by Vixen Media Group
Paid subscription (standalone or Vixen Plus bundle)
Editorial-grade 4K visuals paired with top-tier casting
